citations.translation: Declared: the source is synchronous and states every guarantee as 'within X rounds', with the functionality acting when the round comes. This framework has no ticker and delivery is a pull, so a promised effect is recorded in Due against the source's deadline and fires on Poll -- released early by the adversary or no later than the deadline, the idiom F-net uses for Delta. Every constant is preserved; the activation structure is not. Fourth entry under this translation after F-diffuse, F-beacon and F-TLP.
citations.caveat_finding: Both realization theorems hold only against a restricted environment class E_res, defined in section 3 with the full list in Appendix B -- e.g. the environment may not instruct one party to start a protocol without instructing the other. The authors say the restrictions 'can easily be eliminated by integrating additional checks into the protocols and functionalities', but they were not eliminated, so neither theorem is the unrestricted UC statement. The caveat lives in section 3 rather than beside either theorem and is easy to miss.
